messages:
ops-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED — prod inference 504 spike on rwinf-hostpool-3. Creating scheduling thread for a post-incident review to capture timeline, mitigation, customer impact, and remediation owners. Please propose facilitator and availability.

sanjay: I can facilitate — I ran the live mitigation (rolled back model variant + scaled pool). Available Thu 10:00–11:00 PT or Fri 16:00–17:00 PT. Prefer Thu morning.

tara: Thu 10:00 PT overlaps a customer deep-dive for me. I can do Thu 11:30–12:15 PT or Fri 16:00 PT. I can own the notes + follow-up ticket creation.

liam: I can join either, prefer Fri. Will do customer-impact analysis and bring the list of affected accounts.

maya: I can't do Fri afternoon. If Sanjay facilitates, I can prepare logs/traces and attach KV cache snapshots before the meeting.

sanjay: Ok — rough agenda: 1) timeline + root-cause hypothesis 2) mitigation steps + why they worked 3) customer impact summary 4) action items and owners. 45m + optional 15m follow-up. Need someone to track remediation JIRA.
tara: I'll track JIRA. Planning to use label: postmortem/rwinf-504spike and link back to the meeting doc. I'll create the doc now.

ops-bot: SUGGESTED SLOTS (auto): Thu 2026-03-19 17:00 UTC (10:00 PT), Thu 2026-03-19 18:30 UTC (11:30 PT), Fri 2026-03-20 23:00 UTC (16:00 PT). Use /poll to finalize.

liam: Thu 18:30 UTC (11:30 PT) works for me — pick that one if others can.

sanjay: Sounds good. Tara — can you send invite for Thu 18:30 UTC? Also please include meeting doc + link to logs we need attached.

tara: Sending invite now. Meeting doc: https://docs.internal/postmortems/rwinf-504spike — I'll add preliminary timeline + mitigation notes. Adding calendar invite to eng-oncall & eng-sre. Invite sent from tara@redwood.com.

maya: I'll upload traces and the hostpool scaling logs to the doc before the meeting. ETA: 2 hours.

liam: Customer impact notes: ~12 customers saw latency spikes up to ~12s; 1 customer experienced a 503 error. I'll add account IDs and request CS outreach where needed.

sanjay: Action list (agreed): Sanjay — facilitate + produce 1-paragraph executive summary; Tara — create JIRA(s) and track remediation, add labels and link to doc; Maya — attach traces and logs to doc; Liam — customer impact analysis + list of accounts and recommended outreach. Target: create tickets within 2 business days.

ops-bot: Reminder: set meeting length 45m + 15m SRE follow-up. Auto-generated checklist added to doc.

tara: noted :thumbsup: I'll also add a 'rollback playbook' follow-up item to the tickets.

sanjay: Thanks all. If anything changes ping in this thread. We'll run the postmortem as scheduled and publish a short summary to #postmortems after review.

liam: Thanks — I'll prep the customer impact section and drop it in the doc tonight.

maya: uploaded traces and a quick grep output in the doc (attached).

tara: copied — invite shows Thu 18:30 UTC, 45m. See you then.

ops-bot: Thread closed for scheduling. Postmortem doc link pinned: https://docs.internal/postmortems/rwinf-504spike.
